title: open62541 Subscription Use-After-Free Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
description:
This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of open62541. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability.
The specific flaw exists within the handling of subscriptions. The issue results from the lack of validating the existence of an object prior to performing operations on the object. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the service account.
